# Step - as_duration

`as_duration` · category: [Dates and times](../../traversal/step_reference.md#dates-and-times)

Converts ISO 8601 text to a duration.

## Forms

```text
as_duration()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject("P1D").as_duration().next().days   // 1
```
